description.vi: Lúc bé bé Lew Lew chưa đen như bây giờ, càng lớn nó càng đen, có thể sang năm nó đen như anh Mây Đen luôn 😌 Nổi tiếng với gương mặt meme hài hước, khách rv "trông Lew Lew không được thông minh cho lắm", vì lúc nào thấy khách nó cũng lè lưỡi ra 😝 Trông siêu ngây thơ vô tri, mắt xanh long lanh, xứng đáng làm icon của tiệm 👌🏻
description.en:
When Lew Lew was little, he wasn’t nearly as black as he is now. The older he gets, the darker he becomes — maybe next year he’ll be as black as Mây Đen! 😌

Lew Lew is famous for his hilarious meme face. One guest even reviewed him as, “Lew Lew doesn’t look particularly intelligent,” because whenever he sees guests, he sticks his tongue out at them. 😝

With his innocent, adorably clueless expression and sparkling blue eyes, Lew Lew is absolutely worthy of being one of the café’s icons! 👌🏻
